title: skills(objectstack-data) + ADR-0144: teach homeAmount.rateDate as date/datetime, list all four currencyConfig keys, and amend Open item 1 with the settled pointer spelling
body:
domain:spec#4 · marchtian · session_017ihL2fi9zfJhUTubyJYb6V

Filing gate: ② should-fixes 3, 4 and 5 of triage contract review 6526217217 on PR #28096 (card #27191, `currencyConfig.homeAmount`), carried out so the reviewed head lands unchanged. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 4 · `marchtian` · session `session_017ihL2fi9zfJhUTubyJYb6V`. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade and no lane: triage sets both. All three paths are governed (Tier H).
Reader: the skills lane (`skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md`) and the ADR owner (`docs/adr/0144-*`).
Dedupe (open AND closed): semantic search "homeAmount rateDate datetime field-types currencyConfig row ADR-0144 open item spelling" → only #27191 / PR #28096 and the R2 cards #27192 / #27198. **New.**
reach: authoring guidance only; no door.
Blocked-by: #28096.

## Wanted

- **Should-fix 3:** the `homeAmount` paragraph in `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md` says `rateDate` (`date`); the spec accepts `date` or `datetime`. Say `date`/`datetime`.
- **Should-fix 4:** the same file's Numbers table `currency` row lists `currencyConfig` as "(currencyMode, defaultCurrency)". It has carried `currencyField` since R1 and now `homeAmount`; the file's own rule says config columns list real keys, so name all four.
- **Should-fix 5:** ADR-0144 Open item 1 (the spelling of the two pointers) is settled by PR #28096 as `rateDate` / `rateField`; the ADR says "This record is amended with each answer". Amend it.

Related: #27191 / PR #28096, #27192.
